derivation:
by
  unfold lift
  exact MonoidHom.ext fun x => PresentedGroup.toGroup.unique _ φ (fun p => hφ p.1 p.2)
explanation: Specialize the uniqueness theorem for presented groups to the Steinberg relations and the generator map fun p => f p.1 p.2. Homomorphism extensionality converts its pointwise conclusion into equality.
